data.title: Waterfront evenings, shaded afternoons, and late-light dining
data.intro: Lisbon in summer is about protecting the middle of the day so the evenings can stretch. These packages are built around that rhythm.

data.title: Keep the middle of the day cool so the evenings can stretch long
data.body: The waterfront at Santos doesn’t get interesting until after 7pm. Plan the afternoon around shade — a museum interior, a long lunch, a gallery — and save the energy for later.

data.title: Waterfront afternoons and rooftop dinners
data.summary: Shaded museum stops, a sunset sailing slot, and two dinner reservations near Santos. Built for the warm-weather version of the city.

data.title: Alfama rooftops and river club check-in
data.summary: The year-round Lisbon stay — a riverside hotel, tram pass, and an Alfama food walk that works in any season.
